description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams' that extends 'FilterParams' and serves as a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employment status search queries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods related to filtering by 'name' and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for employment status search filters, allowing to set and get filtering criteria such as 'name' and to specify allowed sorting fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'es.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter, which can be null.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter property.
